'''Awdrysta Pina's blades''' were a pair of [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|Force-imbued blades]] created in the forges of [[Vur Tepe]]. The blades were curved and emitted a soft [[Color/Legends|green]] glow. Their hilts were set with emeralds. According to legend, the blades were used to kill [[Xendor]], who led the [[Legions of Lettow]], but disappeared with [[Awdrysta Pina|Pina]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="FDCR" />
